data.summary: FunkNetz Mobil GmbH confirmed your mobile contract FunkNetz Smart M, ordered on 11 November 2024, dated 12 November 2024. It costs €34.99 per month with a 24-month minimum term starting 15 November 2024.
data.explanation: This confirms your mobile phone contract (Mobilfunkvertrag) with a 24-month minimum term from 15 November 2024. To end it, you must give one month's notice to the end of the minimum term. Otherwise it continues indefinitely and can then be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. You can cancel in text form, for example by email, or through the customer portal button. The app calculates the cancellation deadline. Your SIM card and PIN/PUK arrive separately. The attached withdrawal information (Widerrufsbelehrung) was not included in the text.
